name: A3 byte-identical renderer and analysis performance
order: Complete baseline population first, then candidate. No accuracy inspection or partial comparison.
invariants: SHA-256 of every float32 microphone byte
Canonical value SHA-256 of complete render including diagnostics and every typed-array byte
Canonical value SHA-256 of measured inference
acceptance: Every hash identical in both repetitions; core signal goldens untouched; full baseline and candidate populations required. Report wall timings per repetition and median speed ratio; sequential-order thermal/runtime noise is a limitation.
candidate: Cache moving-source per-knot spectra shared across microphones; cache identical Hann windows and correlation phasors. Do not reorder arithmetic.

measurement_amendment.reason: The original Node V8 serialize hash is not canonical: equal-input baseline repetitions yielded different complete-render hashes. It therefore cannot establish an output change. All four candidate microphone-audio and inference hashes matched, but no optimisation is accepted on that incomplete invariant.
measurement_amendment.replacement: scripts/lib/value-hash.mjs hashes sorted object keys, ordered array elements, exact primitive values and typed-array constructor/length/raw bytes. Repeated references are compared by output value, not allocator identity/alignment. Unsupported object types throw.
measurement_amendment.repeat: Preserve the complete original eight-run evidence with an invalid-serialization suffix. Repeat the same complete eight-run population, baseline first then candidate, only after this amendment is committed. No accuracy or population changes.
